description: This file defines the 'Mem' class within the OpenCart system's cache library namespace. It implements a cache system using Memcache, providing methods to get, set, and delete cache entries, along with configuration and connection management.

classes.name: Mem
classes.description: A cache class using Memcache for storing and retrieving cached data within the OpenCart system's cache library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Memcache connection with a specified expire time, defaulting to 3600 seconds.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value associated with the provided key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with the specified key and optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cached item associated with the specified key.
